messages:
zoe: heads-up: spotted a spike in gpu onboarding failures in us-west-1 after the new network-hardening rule set landed. nodes stuck in ProvisioningPending.
harry: which rule set? i reviewed the PR but didnt expect kms egress to be impacted.
zoe: rule block for egress to non-approved nat ranges landed. it ended up denying the warm-pool nat gw because the prefix-list was replaced with a stricter set. keystore traffic to kms couldn't reach via nat.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: net-hardening-v2 applied to us-west-1 at 2026-03-27T18:12Z (change NH-2026-412).
maya: logs: ```
keystore-proxy ERROR: dial tcp 10.8.22.9:443->remote 34.201.10.77:443: connect timeout
agent.join: state=ProvisioningPending attempts=3 reason="kms handshake timeout"
```
zoe: immediate mitigation: created a temporary allowlist exception for the warm-pool egress to allow 443 to the nat gw IPs. command: `infractl firewall exception create --scope subnet/warm-pool-usw1 --dest 34.201.8.0/24 --port 443 --ttl 30m --note \"temp keystore egress allowlist\"`
ops-bot: monitor: warm-pool-usw1 healthy_nodes: 10 -> 48 (6m) :white_check_mark:
harry: recovery confirmed. cost impact: we saw ~7 gpu-hours of wasted warmups and retries; rough estimate $1.8k for the incident window. add to incident cost.
zoe: root cause: prefix-list swap didn't include dependent nat CIDRs. fix path: (1) roll NH-2026-412 back, (2) update prefix-list dependency map to include NAT CIDRs and keystore endpoints, (3) add preflight e2e check in infra CI that spins a canary warm-pool instance and verifies KMS decrypt before merge.
maya: ops note: role-boundary prevented on-call SRE from editing the prefix-list, which slowed mitigation. propose a scoped operator role allowing audited, time-limited network exceptions for warm-pool keystore egress.
audit-bot: exception created id=EXC-6932 by zoe; linked change=NH-2026-412; expires=2026-03-27T18:42Z. audit-trail will include operator command and justification.
harry: follow-ups: update PR checklist to require "keystore egress impact" checkbox, add automated prefix-list dependency lint, and make a runbook for infra exceptions that doesn't need full net-admin role.
zoe: opened RED-OPS-2209 "prefix-list swap dropped NAT CIDRs -> keystore decrypt failures -> gpu warmup churn" and attached logs, exception id, and cost snapshot.
maya: i'll draft the operator role proposal and a short playbook for on-call next 24h.
harry: closing when PR rework + preflight test merged and the new operator flow is live.
